FamilyTree.title: FamilyTree
FamilyTree.description: A top-level family tree workspace owned by a single authenticated user.

ownerId.description: Authenticated user UID who owns this family tree.

name.description: Display name of the family tree.

description.description: Optional summary description of the family lineage.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the tree was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the tree was last updated.

FamilyMember.title: FamilyMember
FamilyMember.description: A profile record for a single individual within a family tree.

treeId.description: Identifier of the parent family tree.

ownerId.description: UID of the tree owner for O(1) secure list queries.

fullName.description: Full name of the family member.

dateOfBirth.description: Optional ISO date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD) or empty string.

manualAge.description: Optional manual age (0-130) when DOB is not provided, or null.

address.description: Optional home address or ancestral village.

photoUrl.description: Optional compressed profile avatar data URL or HTTPS image URL.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the member record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the member record was last modified.

FamilyRelationship.title: FamilyRelationship
FamilyRelationship.description: A relationship edge connecting two members within a family tree.

treeId.description: Identifier of the parent family tree.

ownerId.description: UID of the tree owner for O(1) secure list queries.

personId.description: Source member ID (e.g., parent for parent_child).

relatedPersonId.description: Target member ID (e.g., child for parent_child).

customLabel.description: Optional custom label when relationshipType is 'other'.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the relationship was created.

/family_trees/{treeId}/members/{memberId.description: Family member profiles belonging to a specific family tree.

/family_trees/{treeId}/relationships/{re.description: Relationship links between family members inside a family tree.
